# Every finding is reported; only high-risk ones fail the scan. Ignore a rule only with a reason.

column3: SQL Injection (generic boolean): false positive. The rate limiter answers part of the attack requests with 429, so true/false payloads differ. Kartei builds no SQL from input (Django ORM only); the PostgreSQL time-based rule 40022 stays active.
Cookie No HttpOnly Flag: only csrftoken, which the SPA must read to send X-CSRFToken (Django CSRF design); the session cookie is HttpOnly.
